home.lede: A quiet, precise voice workspace. Write it, hear it; say it, write it.
home.orbLabel: Press and hold to speak, release to transcribe
home.hint: Type text, press Enter to speak
home.speakError: Could not speak that text. Please try again, or switch engines on the TTS page.

tts.title: Text to Speech
tts.subtitle: Write it, hear it. Dial in a voice and generate natural speech.
tts.overCap: This engine accepts up to {cap} characters
tts.voiceEmpty: No voices are available for this engine
tts.pitchUnsupported: This engine does not support pitch adjustment
tts.engineSwitched: Switched to {name}. The voice was reset.
tts.noOtherVoice: This engine has no available voices

player.error: Could not load the audio. Please try again.

errors.INVALID_ARGUMENT: Some settings are invalid. Check the text and voice, then try again.
errors.TEXT_TOO_LONG: This text exceeds the engine's limit. Shorten it and try again.
errors.UNSUPPORTED_CAPABILITY: This engine does not support the selected option. Try another engine or setting.
errors.QUOTA_EXCEEDED: You have used today's synthesis quota. It resets at midnight.
errors.NOT_FOUND: This job no longer exists. Please generate it again.
errors.RATE_LIMITED: Too many requests. Wait a moment and try again.
errors.PROVIDER_TIMEOUT: The speech service timed out. Retry or switch engines.
errors.PROVIDER_UNAVAILABLE: The speech service is temporarily unavailable. Retry later or switch engines.
errors.INTERNAL: Something went wrong on our side. Retry or switch engines.
errors.NETWORK: Network request failed. Check your connection and try again.
errors.EXPIRED: This job did not finish in time. Please retry.
